newsitem.title: USA: Sen. Harkin urges Clinton pick pro-growth Fed govs.
newsitem.headline: Sen. Harkin urges Clinton pick pro-growth Fed govs.

text.p: Sen. Tom Harkin Wednesday urged President Clinton to pick pro-growth appointees to fill two Federal Reserve vacancies.
The Democrat from Iowa in a letter to Clinton said: "I urge you to nominate persons who will support policies to promote a higher rate of economic growth."
Harkin, a frequent critic of the Fed, said he was "deeply troubled" by the Fed's recent action to raise interest rates.
The Fed has two vacancies for governors due to the resignations of Janet Yellen and Lawrence Lindsey.

"These two nominations are crucial," Harkin wrote. "I urge you to fill the two vacancies on the Board of Governors with persons who will be advocates for the view that lower unemployment and a higher rate of growth should be a key priority of the Federal Reserve's monetary policy," he said.
